review.official:
Thermal-EX (also known as THRM-EX) is a high-performance version of the Raythean Challenger™ Hellcat operating platform, jointly customized by
Mayer
and
Closure
. Between the two, Mayer was primarily responsible for the development and improvement of the weapon and energy supply systems. Thermal-EX is a rather peculiar presence and is extremely enthusiastic towards others, a characteristic that is beloved by some people and disliked by others. However, Thermal-EX remains undaunted, committed to using his incandescent personality to bring warmth to others in this frigid world.
As a new model, Thermal-EX's boasts a unique and aggressive appearance that can be somewhat intimidating. But he doesn't mind. After all, anyone can hear Thermal-EX's loud and warm greetings from a distance long before he's clearly visible. However, it seems like his vocabulary has been excessively bloated with words pertaining to "hot"...

files.description:
[Top Speed] 22.2km/h 
[Climb] Normal 
[Brake] Normal 
[Mobility] Normal 
[Endurance] Defective 
[Structural Integrity] Standard

Thermal-EX is full of praise for everyone he knows, but his greatest praise is reserved for the work Mayer did to retrofit him, even eclipsing his attitude towards Closure's original decision to modify him. Consequently, it is difficult to discern what his personal preferences might be, because everything he says is dominated by appreciation and enthusiasm. 
'Unexpectedly, even some introverted and normally unsociable Operators are willing to spend the day with him and listen to his endless prattling... but this too is good. I've decided to scrap my plan to reconfigure his language prioritization logic.' That's what Closure said.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Thermal-EX, ready to commence thermal shock! What, the designated combat time has not been reached yet? Then, I shall postpone it. Commencing thermal shock after a delay of 10 seconds!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I have heard an expression from the East: 'No martial art is infallible, except for heat.'

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, it's great to be with you! My burning heart won't calm down! —I'm talking about the Raythean Industries custom-made full-thermal Arts impact generator on my body!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: In the beginning, God said, 'Let there be light,' and there was light. God said, 'Let there be power,' and there was the high-performance variant of Raythean's Challenger Hellcat.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: As a perfect industrial-grade mass-produced combat platform, I am very happy now! Not only do I get regular performance optimizations from Mayer, but I even get to work with passionate partners like Blaze! Life is so good!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Even though I'm already this dazzling, only you, the peerless Doctor, are worthy of becoming the brightest sun!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I know that the heat and light I emit is so very short-lived... But all that matters is that I can illuminate the path before you, Doctor!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Even when you're asleep, I can continue to work as your heater! I'm incredible!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Born from Raythean Industries, improved by the hands of the great Mayer. I, Thermal-EX, the throbbing heart of hotness, am here to help!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Ohhhhh! This power blazing within me... It's… It's… It's a hotfix!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Now, it's my turn to show off!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: What's the situation?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: All units, move out!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Rock and roll!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Ready to launch!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Charging up!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm here to help!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Detonation imminent!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Sonic boom—!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Deploying thermal shock!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Watch this!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Praise the heat!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Aren't I awesome? I knew your command would be a perfect match for me, Doctor!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: BRAVO~ BRAVO~!!!! Doctor!!!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: My retreat was just a fluke. Nothing must be allowed through our net on the battlefield.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Contact! Contact! Enemy ambush! Dropping smoke! Doctor, I'll cover your retreat!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Rest? Haha, it's too early for me! I just swapped to the newest energy storage device, so we have fifty more hours until the end of the workday!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: A-ha! My thermal sensor feels your burning heart!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Your burning enthusiasm has melted my processor!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! There's too much excess and zero majesty to playing songs on Monster Siren hi-fis and related devices! Allow me to use a hotter, more direct method to boost the vigor of this fireworks show! BANG!! Pewwwwww... BANG!!!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Welcome back, Doctor! I see that you're also full of light and heat today!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I hear the others are expressing their feelings of fondness for you by way of gifts, but you and I have no need for such tedious things to express our emotions! Our hearts have long been connected through heat and impact! Doctor! Happy birthday!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor!! Even I'm dazzled by the liveliness of this spectacle! Hesitate no more, come with me! Let us celebrate with the others!
